content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would like to know if my method for configuring analog inputs and outputs in [product_name] is correct. My setup includes a 0-10V sensor connected to input I2, using an AI4 block as the compatible option. This block then connects to a PI regulation block, whose output goes to the analog output AQ1. In my simulation, varying the value of I2 between 0 and 1000 also changes AQ1 between these same values. Shouldn’t the output instead range from 0 to 10V? Looking for clarification. Thank you and apologies for any language mistakes.

Hello, The system uses units of 0.01V for analog values: 0 = 0V 250 = 2.5V 500 = 5V 1000 = 10V For further details, refer to the built-in help and [document]. There are also example projects at [url]. Regards,

Hello, It’s important to know which [product_name] base module you’re using, as not all versions include onboard analog support. Certain models do support analog onboard functions, while some do not. Regards

Inputs: The settings can be adjusted. In the analog block configuration, you may assign values for inputs with different sensor types (such as PT100, PT1000, or other sensors with 0–10V or 4–20mA). You can specify measurement values corresponding to 0V and 10V analog inputs with linear scaling. Output: Conversion is not possible. In [product_name], a value of 0 means 0V at the output, while a value of 1000 means 10V output.
